blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While 2D Vision Foundation Models offer a pathway to automate 3D semantic pseudo-labelling, translating these priors into robust 3D representations typically requires complex heuristics or multi-model ensembles. We introduce SplatLabel, an automated pipeline that leverages a 4D Gaussian representation to extract LiDAR segmentation with predictive confidence, as well as semantic occupancy grids at arbitrary voxel resolutions. At its core, SplatLabel handles dynamic environments through an explicit temporal manifold that models the trajectories and lifespans of individual 3D primitives. This allows the system to accurately track moving actors and strictly define when objects appear and disappear, completely eliminating the need for pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes. To robustly support this dynamic tracking, the representation is grounded by structural and semantic priors: we guide scene geometry in unobserved regions by integrating 360-degree LiDAR via virtual depth maps, and rather than relying on domain-specific prompt engineering, we directly distill continuous soft probabilities from 2D models to inherently resolve semantic ambiguities over time and space. Finally, to accurately reflect the real-world trade-off between precision and recall, we reframe pseudo-label evaluation as a selective classification task using a generalized risk-recall metric. Experiments on SemanticKITTI demonstrate that SplatLabel consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple recall levels, establishing a highly robust framework for both 3D LiDAR segmentation and occupancy prediction.
blocks.zh: 虽然2D展望基金会 模型提供了将3D语义伪标签自动化的路径,将这些前科转换成强力的3D表示通常需要复杂的heuristic或多模型的组合. 我们引入了SplatLabel, 一种自动管道, 它利用一个4D高斯代表 以预测的置信度提取LiDAR分化, 以及语义占用网 任意的 voxel 分辨率。 其核心是SplatLabel通过一个明确的时间倍数处理动态环境,模拟单个3D原始生物的轨迹和寿命. 这使得系统能够准确跟踪移动的演员,并严格定义物体何时出现和消失,从而完全消除了预先附加说明的3D边框的需要. 为了有力地支持这种动态跟踪,该表示以结构学和语义学前科为基础:我们通过虚拟深度图将360度的LiDAR集成在未观测区域引导场景几何,而不是依赖特定域的即时工程,我们直接从2D模型中提炼出持续的软概率,以内在地解决语义学在时间和空间上的模糊. 最后,为了准确反映准确性和回顾性之间的现实取舍,我们重新将伪标签评价定为一项选择性的分类任务,使用通用风险回顾指标。 关于语义学KITTI的实验表明,SplatLabel在多个召回水平上一贯超过最先进的基线,为3D LiDAR分区和占用率预测建立了非常有力的框架。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Comprehensive 3D semantic perception is a fundamental prerequisite for autonomous systems [ 1 , 2 ] . However, the manual annotation required for training robust models is prohibitively expensive, prompting the use of 2D Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to automatically generate 3D pseudo-labels [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Concurrently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful explicit radiance field representation [ 7 ] . Yet, despite its rapid adoption, 3DGS optimization remains overwhelmingly focused on novel view synthesis, leaving its potential as a continuous backbone for spatial pseudo-labelling underutilized.
blocks.zh: 综合3D语义感知是自主系统[1,2]的一个基本前提. 然而,训练强力模型所需的人工注释却过于昂贵,促使使用2D视野基础模型自动生成3D伪标签[3,4,5,6]. 同时, 3D Gaussian Splateting(3DGS)作为强大的明亮的场面代表出现[7]. 然而,3DGS尽管迅速采用,但其优化仍绝大多数侧重于新观点合成,使其有可能成为空间伪标签利用不足的连续支柱。

blocks.en: Current automated 3D pseudo-labelling pipelines face critical bottlenecks when moving beyond static environments. Most notably, modeling dynamic scenes typically requires pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes to cleanly separate moving actors from static backgrounds [ 8 , 9 ] , creating a circular dependency that defeats the purpose of annotation-free pseudo-labelling. Furthermore, extracting consistent semantic features and integrating 360-degree LiDAR geometry to support these scenes demands complex heuristics, multi-model ensembles, or computationally heavy spherical rasterization to counteract temporal inconsistencies and visual occlusion [ 4 , 6 , 10 , 11 ] . Finally, existing baselines evaluate pseudo-label quality strictly on successfully labeled points, fundamentally ignoring the crucial trade-off between arbitrary recall levels and overall label accuracy.
blocks.zh: 目前的自动3D伪标签管道在超越静态环境时面临关键的瓶颈. 最值得注意的是,建模动态场景一般需要预先附加说明的3D边框来清理移动的演员与静态背景[8,9],从而形成循环依赖性,从而辜负了无注释假标签的目的. 此外,提取一致的语义特征和整合360度的LiDAR几何来支撑这些场景,需要复杂的heuristic,多模型的集合,或计算重球光圈化来抵消时间不一致和视觉隐蔽[4,6,10,11]. 最后,现有基线严格根据成功标注的标点评价伪标签质量,从根本上忽略了任意召回水平与总标签准确性之间的关键权衡.

blocks.en: To solve these challenges, we propose SplatLabel, an automated 4D Gaussian Splatting pipeline designed specifically for 3D semantic pseudo-labelling and volumetric occupancy prediction. Rather than treating motion as a post-processing step or relying on implicit global deformations, SplatLabel unifies explicit spatial representation, structural densification, and kinematic tracking into a single continuous optimization framework driven by a fully parameterized temporal manifold. By doing so, we address the core limitations of existing pipelines and establish a robust, annotation-free foundation for dynamic scene understanding. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议使用SplatLabel,一个自动的4D高斯电镀管道,专门为3D语义伪标签和体积占用预测设计. SplatLabel不是将运动视为处理后步骤或依赖隐含的全球变形,而是将明确的空间代表、结构密度和运动跟踪统一为一个完全参数化的时间倍数驱动的单一连续优化框架。 通过这样做,我们解决了现有管道的核心局限性,并为动态场景理解奠定了坚实、无注释的基础。 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: Explicit Temporal Manifold for Dynamic Scenes: We parameterize motion and temporal existence boundaries as intrinsic properties of individual 3D Gaussians. By utilizing a Dual Deformation Kernel [ 12 ] coupled with a Gated Deformation Mask and explicit temporal lifespans, SplatLabel achieves robust, object-centric tracking. This naturally separates moving actors from the static background across time without the need for pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes [ 8 , 9 ] or unpredictable black-box motion models [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 动态场景的明确时间操作符 : 我们把运动和时间存在边界参数化为个人3D高斯人的内在属性. SplatLabel通过使用双变形核心[12]加盖变形罩和明确的时间寿命,实现了稳健的、以物体为中心的跟踪。 这自然地将演员与静止背景隔开,跨越时间,不需要预先附加说明的3D边框[8,9]或不可预测的黑盒运动模型[13].

blocks.en: Spatiotemporal Distillation and Geometric Priors: We fundamentally advance 3DGS optimization by dynamically regulating primitive capacity through LiDAR priors. By backpropagating continuous soft semantics directly from 2D VFMs [ 14 ] , our continuous optimization inherently filters out single-frame noise and resolves categorical ambiguities through spatiotemporal consensus, eliminating the need for domain-specific prompt engineering [ 4 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 螺旋分裂和几何前传: 我们从根本上推进3DGS优化,通过LiDAR前传动态调节原始容量. 通过直接从2D VFM [14] 中反射连续软语义,我们持续优化内在过滤出单帧噪声,并通过spatiopal共识解决断然的模糊性,消除了针对特定域的快速工程[4,6]的需要.

blocks.en: Pseudo-Labelling as Selective Classification: We establish a mathematically grounded framework to evaluate pseudo-labelling systems. By reformulating evaluation as a selective classification task using the class-averaged Area Under the Generalized Risk-Coverage (AUGRC) [ 15 ] metric, we directly capture the risk of injecting noisy labels into downstream training, revealing the true performance-recall trade-offs ignored by standard baselines [ 4 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: Pseudo-Labelling 作为选择性分类: 我们建立了一个基于数学的框架,以评估伪标签系统。 通过将评价重新确定为选择性分类任务,使用通用风险-overage(AUGRC)[15] 度量下的班级平均区,我们直接捕捉到向下游培训注入吵闹标签的风险,揭示标准基线忽略的真正业绩-召回权衡[4,6].

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Spatiotemporal Semantic Distillation in 3DGS
blocks.zh: 3DGS中的 Spatiotemporal 语义分裂

blocks.en: 3DGS models scenes using an explicit radiance field of anisotropic Gaussian primitives [ 7 ] . Typically initialized from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) point clouds [ 16 ] , each discrete primitive is parameterized by a 3D center, covariance, opacity, and spherical harmonics [ 7 ] . While 3DGS achieves highly efficient rendering, its original photometric gradient-based densification heuristics are extremely fragile [ 7 , 17 ] . Crucially, introducing semantic and depth supervision fundamentally alters these loss scales, which vary significantly depending on the total number of classes or the specific foundation model utilized, causing standard densification heuristics to struggle. To address this, recent work reformulates 3DGS optimization as a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling process via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) [ 17 , 18 ] . This approach naturally explores the scene landscape and manages primitive capacity irrespective of disrupted gradient scales [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 3DGS模型场景使用异同位素高斯原始物的明亮光场[7]. 通常从结构-从-运动(SfM)点云[16]初始化,每个离散的原始物由一个3D中心参数化,共变,不透明,以及球形的口音[7]. 虽然3DGS实现了高度高效的渲染,但其最初的光度梯度式的密度热度极其脆弱[7,17]. 关键的是,引入语义学和深度监督从根本上改变了这些损失尺度,这些损失尺度因所用类别总数或具体基础模型的不同而大不相同,导致标准密度高血压发生挣扎. 为了解决这一问题,最近的工作通过Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD)[17, 18] 将3DGS优化为马可夫链式蒙特卡洛(MCC)取样过程. 这种方法自然探索场景地貌,管理原始能力,无论梯度尺度是否中断[17].

blocks.en: Beyond geometry, Gaussians explicitly store high-dimensional semantic features without structural modifications [ 19 , 7 ] , enabling memory-efficient semantic occupancy prediction [ 20 , 21 ] and sensor fusion [ 22 , 23 ] . Concurrently, 3D semantic pseudo-labelling has advanced by transferring knowledge from 2D VFMs to 3D spaces [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . However, extracting consistent semantics typically demands complex prompt formulation or multi-model ensembles to counteract temporal inconsistencies and single-frame label flickering [ 4 , 6 ] . SplatLabel overcomes this by directly distilling continuous soft logits into a 4D Gaussian representation, natively converging on a unified semantic identity across time and space.
blocks.zh: 除几何外,高斯人还明确存储高维语义特征,而不进行结构修改[19,7],使得内存高效的语义占用预测[20,21]和传感器聚变[22,23]成为可能. 同时,通过将知识从2D VFM转移到3D空间[3, 4, 5, 6],3D语义伪标签已经进步. 然而,提取一致的语义通常需要复杂的即时配体或多模式的组合来抵消时间不一致和单帧标签闪烁[4,6]. SplatLabel通过直接将连续的软对数分解成一个4D高斯代表,在本土凝聚了跨越时间和空间的统一语义特征,从而克服了这一点.

blocks.en: II-B LiDAR-Guided Geometric Optimization
blocks.zh: II-B LiDAR 定向几何优化

blocks.en: While VFMs provide rich 2D semantic priors, accurately lifting these labels into 3D requires robust underlying geometry. The integration of LiDAR into 3DGS typically enforces structural constraints through pseudo-depth projection onto camera planes [ 24 , 25 ] , but frequently discards LiDAR measurements outside the visual frustum [ 26 , 11 , 24 ] . To utilize 360-degree sweeps, recent methods develop explicit LiDAR sensor models utilizing specialized spherical rasterization [ 26 , 11 ] , which introduce significant computational complexity. Crucially, prior approaches treat LiDAR strictly as a post-rendering supervision signal rather than an explicit densification trigger. To fully utilize 360-degree sweeps without heavy spherical rasterizers, SplatLabel introduces Virtual Depth Maps and a Geometry-Guided sampler that actively spawns primitives in structurally inconsistent regions.
blocks.zh: 虽然VFM提供了丰富的2D语义前传,但准确的将这些标签提升到3D需要坚固的基础几何. 将LiDAR整合到3DGS中,一般通过伪深度投射到相机平面上[24,25]来强制实施结构约束,但经常将LiDAR的测量结果丢在视觉壁膜外[26,11,24]. 为了利用360度的扫射,最近的方法开发了清晰的LiDAR传感器模型,利用专门的球面光栅化[26,11],引入了重大的计算复杂性. 关键是,前置方法严格地将LiDAR视为后置监督信号,而不是明显的密度触发器. 为了充分利用没有重球光栅的360度扫瞄,SplatLabel引入了虚拟深度地图和一个几何定向采样器,在结构不一致的区域积极产卵原始人.

blocks.en: II-C Dynamic Scene Modeling and the Temporal Manifold
blocks.zh: II-C 动态场景建模和临时操纵器

blocks.en: Despite the geometric fidelity achieved in static scenes, real-world environments are inherently dynamic. Importantly, the vast majority of continuous 4DGS frameworks are designed exclusively for novel view synthesis [ 8 , 9 , 12 , 13 , 24 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] , largely overlooking how these rich spatiotemporal representations can be repurposed for dense scene annotation.
blocks.zh: 尽管在静态场景中实现了几何忠诚,但现实世界的环境本质上是动态的. 重要的是,绝大多数连续的4DGS框架的设计完全是为了新颖的景色综合[8,9,12,13,24,26,27,28],基本上忽略了这些丰富的瞬间表现如何可以重新用于密集的场景注释.

blocks.en: Supervised frameworks achieve high geometric fidelity by separating moving foregrounds from static backgrounds [ 8 , 9 ] . Annotation-free approaches utilize either implicit global environmental deformations [ 29 , 13 ] , or explicit representations that treat motion as an intrinsic property of the 3D primitives [ 28 , 12 , 27 ] . However, while implicit methods like CODA-4DGS [ 13 ] effectively model dynamic context, they allow semantic features to deform and alter across time. This continuous semantic morphing contradicts physical reality for label extraction, where an object’s core semantic identity must remain firmly grounded and constant. Conversely, while explicit models provide the object-centric tracking required for pseudo-labelling, isolating dynamic actors typically requires pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes, creating a circular dependency for self-supervised systems. SplatLabel resolves this through a bounding-box-free explicit Dual Deformation Kernel [ 12 ] and a fully parameterized temporal manifold, cleanly separating moving actors from static backgrounds while strictly preserving their semantic identities.
blocks.zh: 监督框架通过将移动前缘与静态背景分开来达到高几何忠诚度[8,9]. 无注释方法要么利用隐含的全球环境变形[29、13],要么利用将运动视为3D原始物的固有财产的明确表述[28、12、27]。 然而,虽然像CODA-4DGS[13]这样的隐含方法有效地模拟了动态上下文,但它们允许语义特征变形并随着时间的推移而变化. 这种连续的语义形态与标签提取的物理现实相矛盾,在这种现实中,物体的核心语义特征必须坚固和恒定. 反之,虽然显性模型提供了伪标签所需的以对象为中心的跟踪,但隔离动态角色通常需要预先附加说明的3D绑定框,形成自我监督系统的循环依赖性. SplatLabel通过一个无边框的显式双变形核心[12]和一个完全参数化的时间多倍,干净地将移动的演员与静态背景区分开来解决这个问题,同时严格保留其语义特征.

blocks.en: II-D Selective Classification for Pseudo-Label Evaluation
blocks.zh: Pseudo-Label评价的选择性分类

blocks.en: Even with robust explicit tracking, self-supervised pipelines inevitably generate noisy predictions. Consequently, evaluating pseudo-label quality is uniquely challenging. Existing baselines conventionally measure accuracy only on the fraction of points they manage to annotate, failing to account for the widely varying and arbitrary recall levels across different methods. To address this, we draw from the broader machine learning literature, where selective classification is utilized to explicitly evaluate the trade-off between coverage (recall) and accuracy [ 30 , 31 ] . However, simply adopting standard selective metrics like the Area Under the Risk-Coverage curve (AURC) [ 31 ] introduces new issues: they calculate risk strictly over accepted predictions, which disproportionately penalizes high-confidence failures [ 15 ] and frequently mask bias by disproportionately rejecting minority classes under severe dataset imbalance [ 32 ] . To overcome both the limitations of standard pseudo-label evaluation and the flaws of naive selective metrics, SplatLabel reformulates LiDAR pseudo-labelling as a selective classification task utilizing a class-averaged Area Under the Generalized Risk-Coverage (AUGRC) metric [ 15 ] , providing a holistic, bias-aware measure of label reliability.
blocks.zh: 即使有了强大的明确跟踪,自我监督的管道也不可避免地会产生噪音的预测. 因此,对伪标签质量的评价具有独特的挑战性。 现有的基准仅按它们设法作出注释的分数来衡量准确性,没有说明不同方法中广泛不同的任意召回水平。 为了解决这一问题,我们借鉴了更广泛的机器学习文献,其中使用了选择性分类来明确评价覆盖范围(回顾)与准确性之间的权衡[30,31]。 然而,仅仅采用风险-overage曲线下的 " 区域 " [31] 之类的标准选择性衡量标准,就提出了新的问题:它们严格地计算风险,而不是接受的预测,这不成比例地惩罚了高度自信的失败[15],并经常掩盖偏见,在严重的数据集不平衡下不成比例地拒绝少数群体类别[32]。 为了克服标准伪标签评价的局限性和天真的选择性度量衡的缺陷,SplatLabel将LiDAR伪标签重订为一种选择性分类任务,使用通用风险-覆盖度(AUGRC)度量标准下分类平均区[15],提供了标签可靠性的整体性,偏差感度量.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Problem Formulation and Overview
blocks.zh: 三-A 问题的提出和概述

blocks.en: Given a continuous sequence of LiDAR point clouds and 2D images, our objective is to generate dense 3D semantic pseudo-labels and volumetric semantic occupancy grids. The fundamental challenge in continuous dynamic scene reconstruction is accurately tracking moving actors while ensuring the static environment remains stable over time.
blocks.zh: 鉴于LiDAR点云和2D图像的连续序列,我们的目标是生成密集的3D语义伪标签和音量语义占用网格. 持续动态现场重建的根本挑战是准确跟踪移动的行为者,同时确保静态环境随着时间的推移保持稳定。

blocks.en: To resolve this, we formulate the scene as a continuous 4D representation strictly governed by an explicit temporal manifold. As illustrated in Figure SplatLabel: Pseudo-Labelling through 4D Gaussian Splatting , our pipeline centers on this manifold by treating motion and temporal lifespan as intrinsic properties of individual Gaussian primitives. While multimodal inputs (LiDAR and 2D semantics) are distilled to manage primitive capacity, the core of our approach lies in explicit kinematic tracking and temporal existence parameterization. This formulation allows the system to accurately define when and where objects appear, seamlessly separating dynamic actors from static backgrounds to achieve a globally consistent 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们把场景描绘成一个连续的4D代表,严格按照明确的时间多面来管理。 如图SplatLabel:Pseudo-Labelling通过4D Gaussian Splatting, 我们的管道通过将运动和时间寿命视为个人Gaussian原始人的内在特性, 虽然多式联运投入(LiDAR和2D语义)被提炼以管理原始能力,但我们方法的核心在于明确的运动跟踪和时间存在参数化。 这种配方使系统能够准确定义物体出现的时间和地点,无缝地将动态角色与静态背景区分开来,实现全球一致的4D重建.

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Performance-recall trade-off on SemanticKITTI [ 1 ] . SplatLabel provides a continuous performance-recall profile, displaying the mean mIoU and standard deviation across five random seeds. Our method’s tight variance and consistent upper bound strictly dominate the single-operating-point baselines, LeAP [ 4 ] and UniLiPs [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 图3:关于语义KITTI的绩效回顾权衡 [1]. SplatLabel提供连续的性能召回剖面,显示5个随机种子的平均mIoU和标准偏差. LeAP [4] 和UniLiPs [6] 严格控制着单一操作点基线。

blocks.en: III-B Spatiotemporal Distillation and Geometric Priors
blocks.zh: III-B 螺旋分裂和几何前传

blocks.en: To build a robust foundation for our temporal manifold, we must first accurately ground our Gaussians in both semantic and geometric reality. Standard photometric gradient-based densification heuristics fail under the altered loss scales introduced by semantic and depth supervision. Therefore, we abandon fragile densification heuristics and build upon stochastic state transitions (MCMC via SGLD) [ 17 ] to dynamically regulate primitive capacity. We extend this framework to natively incorporate multimodal 2D and 3D priors.
blocks.zh: 为了为我们的时间多面性奠定坚实的基础,我们必须首先准确地将我们的高斯人置于语义和几何现实之中。 在语义和深度监督所引入的改变损失尺度下,标准光度梯度密度高的热力学失败。 因此,我们放弃了脆弱的密度高血压学,并借助于有条理的状态过渡(MCMC通过SGLD)[17]来动态调节原始能力. 我们把这一框架扩大到本土纳入2D和3D模式的前身。

blocks.en: III-B 1 Continuous Semantic Distillation
blocks.zh: III-B 1 连续语义消沉

blocks.en: To overcome domain-specific prompt limitations, we directly extract raw logits from Segment Anything Model (SAM) 3 [ 14 ] by querying base dataset labels. This bypasses complex prompt manipulation, yielding dense, continuous soft labels. By backpropagating the semantic loss directly into the Gaussian parameters and aggregating gradients across the entire spatiotemporal sequence, our continuous optimization intrinsically smooths frame-to-frame label flickering and resolves categorical ambiguities (e.g., ‘car’ versus ‘vehicle’).
blocks.zh: 为了克服特定域的即时限制,我们通过查询基础数据集的标签,直接从Side Anything Model(SAM)3[14]中提取原始的日志. 绕过复杂的即时操纵,产生密集,连续的软标签. 通过将语义损失直接传播到高斯语参数中,并汇集整个瞬间序列的梯度,我们不断进行内在优化,使帧对帧的标签闪烁,并解决断然含糊不清的问题(例如 " 汽车 " 与 " 车辆 " )。

blocks.en: III-B 2 Omnidirectional Geometric Supervision
blocks.zh: III-B 2 直径几何监督

blocks.en: Standard camera-frame depth supervision discards crucial 360-degree LiDAR geometry. To supervise visually occluded regions without abandoning the efficient pinhole rasterizer, we introduce Virtual Depth Maps . By explicitly placing artificial cameras in unobserved areas, we project the full LiDAR point cloud to generate virtual depth targets. Furthermore, we integrate these raw LiDAR depth cues directly into our density controller as structural sampling priors. When the system detects regions exhibiting high structural inconsistency between the Gaussian distribution and LiDAR data, it actively prioritizes spawning and adjusting primitives directly within those areas.
blocks.zh: 标准相机帧深度监控丢弃至关重要的360度LiDAR几何. 为了监督视障区域而不放弃高效的针孔光栅,我们引入虚拟深度地图。 通过在未观测地区明确放置人工摄像头,我们投射了完整的LiDAR点云,以产生虚拟深度目标. 此外,我们把这些原始的LiDAR深度提示 直接结合到我们的密度控制器中 作为结构采样前兆。 当系统探测到高斯分布和LiDAR数据之间存在高度结构不一致的区域时,它积极优先进行产卵,并直接在这些区域内调整原始物.

blocks.en: III-C Temporal Manifold Parameterization
blocks.zh: III-C 时间操纵参数化

blocks.en: To accurately model dynamic environments without decoupling moving actors from global environmental deformations, we parameterize motion and temporal existence as an explicit temporal manifold intrinsic to individual Gaussian primitives. This unifies spatial tracking and temporal boundaries into a single continuous representation.
blocks.zh: 为了准确模拟动态环境而不将移动的行为者与全球环境变形脱钩,我们把运动和时间存在参数化为个人高斯原始人所固有的明确的时间多元性。 这就将空间跟踪和时间界限统一为单一的连续表示。

blocks.en: III-C 1 Dual Deformation Kernel
blocks.zh: III-C 1 双重变形 内核

blocks.en: III-C 2 Gated Deformation Mask
blocks.zh: III-C 2 变形 遮罩

blocks.en: Uniformly applying explicit deformation destabilizes static backgrounds. To isolate static geometry, we introduce a learned Sigmoid-Gated Deformation Mask [ 13 ] , which clamps deformation kernels to zero for background structures. Furthermore, moving objects with poorly converged trajectories often suffer low opacity and are consequently pruned. To address this, we integrate the mask directly into our sampling prior as a dynamic-weighted relocalization mechanism. By scaling primitive respawn probabilities with this motion mask, the state transition backend actively prioritizes sampling along dynamic trajectories, ensuring robust reconstruction of moving actors.

blocks.en: III-D Deformation and Trajectory Regularization
blocks.zh: 三-D 变形和轨迹规范化

blocks.en:
While the explicit temporal manifold effectively captures 4D kinematics, it requires regularization to converge to physically plausible states. To ensure the Gated Deformation Mask functions as a strict binary classifier rather than a continuous scaling factor, we apply a combined ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} sparsity penalty and a self-entropy minimization loss. This exerts downward pressure on static geometry while driving mask values strictly toward bistable states ( 0 0 or 1 1 ).
Simultaneously, to prevent overfitting in the polynomial motion framework, we apply a small ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} penalty directly to the trajectory coefficients, which inherently favors smooth paths unless complex motion is heavily supported by structural gradients.
blocks.zh:
虽然明确的时间多面有效捕捉到4D动能,但要求正规化才能与物理上可信的状态汇合。 为了确保Gated变形面具作为严格的二进制分类器而非连续的缩放因子,我们采用了L 1\mathcal{L}_{1}的混合的痉挛惩罚和自发的最小化损失. 这对静态几何造成向下的压力,同时将遮罩值严格朝双表态(0 0 或 11 )推进.
同时,为了防止在多边运动框架中的偏移,我们直接对轨迹系数适用一个小的L 1\ mathcal{L}_{1}的处罚,除非结构梯度大力支持复杂运动,否则这在本质上有利于平滑路径。

blocks.en: III-E Unified Downstream Extraction
blocks.zh: 三-E 统一下游采掘

blocks.en: To demonstrate the versatility of our continuous 4D representation, we extract discrete pseudo-labels for two distinct downstream tasks: LiDAR point cloud segmentation and semantic occupancy prediction. Because 3DGS inherently prioritizes 2D camera coverage, it often generates artifacts in regions lacking depth priors. To ensure high fidelity during this continuous-to-discrete translation, we first apply a Voxel-Based Geometric Filter using accumulated LiDAR point clouds, strictly grounding the extraction in physical scene geometry by removing unconstrained floaters.
blocks.zh: 为了证明我们连续的4D代表的多用途性,我们为两个不同的下游任务提取了离散的伪标签: LiDAR点云分化与语义占用预测. 由于3DGS内在优先使用2D相机覆盖,它经常在缺乏深度前身的区域生成文物. 为了在这种连续到分散的翻译过程中保证高度的忠诚,我们首先使用累积的LiDAR点云使用Voxel基几何滤镜,通过去除不受约束的浮标来严格地在物理场景几何中固定提取.

blocks.en: For point-level LiDAR segmentation, we avoid naive nearest-neighbor assignments by employing an inverse-distance weighted voting scheme among the local Gaussian neighborhood. This spatial consensus out-votes isolated outliers and provides a native uncertainty metric via Shannon Entropy. Similarly, our continuous formulation enables resolution-agnostic semantic occupancy extraction. A target voxel is classified as occupied if it falls within a structurally filtered Gaussian. Its semantic class is derived from the mean consensus of the continuous semantic field queried at its eight bounding vertices, elegantly resolving boundary ambiguities while maintaining spatial coherence.
blocks.zh: 对于点级的LiDAR分区,我们通过在当地高斯街区采用反距离加权投票计划,避免了天真近邻分配. 这种空间共识排出投票的隔断点,通过香农Entropy提供了本土不确定性的度量. 同样,我们不断的提法使解析-不可知语义占用提取成为可能。 如果一个目标Voxel属于结构过滤的Gaussian,则被归类为占用. 其语义类来源于连续语义领域在8个界顶被问及时达成的平均共识,在保持空间一致性的同时优雅地解决了边界模糊问题。

blocks.en: III-F Pseudo-Labelling as Selective Classification
blocks.zh: 作为选择性分类的Pseudo-Labelling

blocks.en: Existing pseudo-labelling baselines frequently evaluate performance strictly on the subset of points they label [ 4 , 6 ] . This evaluation protocol fails to provide a holistic understanding of a pipeline’s efficacy, as it ignores the widely varying and arbitrary recall levels across different methods.
blocks.zh: 现有的伪标签基线经常严格地评价它们所标注的[4,6]点的子集的性能. 这一评估协议未能全面了解管道的效率,因为它忽略了不同方法中差异很大和任意的召回水平。

blocks.en: To resolve this, we propose formulating 3D pseudo-labelling as a selective classification task [ 30 ] . By treating unassigned pseudo-labels as “rejected” predictions, we can evaluate disparate pipelines using robust risk-coverage trade-offs. We utilize Generalized Risk, which quantifies the joint probability that a model accepts a point for pseudo-labelling and that the assigned label is incorrect [ 15 ] . This acts as a direct, practical measure of the risk of injecting noisy labels into downstream training.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们建议制定3D伪标签作为选择性分类任务[30]. 通过将未指定的伪标签作为“拒绝的”预测,我们可以利用有力的风险覆盖权衡来评价不同的管道。 我们使用通用风险,以量化一个模型接受一个点进行伪标签的连带概率,以及指定标签不正确[15]。 这是对向下游培训中注入吵闹标签的风险的一种直接、实际的衡量。

blocks.en: For a given class k k at a global coverage/recall threshold c c , the selective risk is defined as 1 − IoU k , c 1-\text{IoU}_{k,c} , where IoU represents the Intersection over Union. Under severe class imbalance, standard selective global metrics often appear deceptively optimistic by hiding the disproportionate rejection of minority classes [ 32 ] . To ensure a fair, bias-aware evaluation across the entire dataset, we formulate our overall performance metric as the class-averaged Area Under the Generalized Risk-Coverage (AUGRC) curve: A ​ U ​ G ​ R ​ C = ∫ 0 1 ( 1 − mIoU c ) ⋅ c ​ 𝑑 c AUGRC=\int_{0}^{1}(1-\text{mIoU}_{c})\cdot c\,dc (5) Bounded strictly between 0 and 0.5, a lower AUGRC indicates superior performance. By deriving this overall metric from the mean of the class-specific generalized risks, we provide a robust mathematical foundation to evaluate the true precision-recall reliability of any pseudo-labelling system.

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on the SemanticKITTI [ 1 ] validation set (Sequence 08). Semantic features are extracted zero-shot using the SAM 3 [ 14 ] foundation model. Crucially, we eschew complex prompt engineering, opting instead to directly prompt the dataset class names to evaluate the native robustness of our differentiable learning backend. Due to the inherent VRAM constraints associated with optimizing dense 3D Gaussian Splatting over long durations, we divide the sequence into independent, approximately 20-second continuous scenes. These localized scenes are trained independently on NVIDIA A40 GPUs and subsequently stitched together using a primitive alignment strategy during inference.
blocks.zh: 我们在语义KITTI [1] 验证集(第08辑)上评价我们的方法. 语义特征是使用SAM 3[14]基础模型提取的零射. 关键是,我们放弃了复杂的即时工程, 选择直接促进数据集类名称 来评价我们不同学习的后端的原生稳健性。 由于在长时间内优化密集的3D高斯镀层的内在的VRAM限制,我们把序列分为独立的,约20秒连续的场景. 这些局部场景在NVIDIA A40 GPU上独立训练,随后在推论中使用原始对齐策略缝合.

blocks.en: IV-B LiDAR Segmentation and Recall Evaluation
blocks.zh: IV-B LiDAR 分部分和回顾评价

blocks.en: To ensure fair comparisons with existing baselines, we evaluate our results using the 11 common merged classes (car, bicycle, motorcycle, other-vehicle, person, road, sidewalk, other-ground, manmade, vegetation, and terrain) and the six categories (flat, construction, object, nature, human, and vehicle) defined by the KITTI-360 benchmark [ 37 ] . Qualitative segmentation results are visualized in the top rows of Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 为了确保与现有基线的公平比较,我们利用11个共同的合并类别(汽车、自行车、摩托车、其他车辆、人员、道路、人行道、其他地面、人造、植被和地形)和KITTI-360基准界定的6个类别(平面、建筑、物体、自然、人和车辆)来评估我们的成果。 定性分解结果可视化为图2的上行.

blocks.en: Through direct correspondence with the respective authors, we determined that LeAP [ 4 ] generates labels for 65.3% of the points, while UniLiPs [ 6 ] labels an average of 47.32% of the points on the training set. Because our methodology inherently supports continuous evaluation across all recall thresholds via our selective classification formulation, we benchmark our pipeline directly against these baselines at their exact recall levels to ensure absolute fairness. As illustrated in Figure 3 , SplatLabel maintains a superior performance profile across all recall levels, consistently outperforming baseline operating points even when accounting for variance. Global quantitative results at these specific recall thresholds are summarized in Table I . As detailed in Table I , our method struggles specifically with the ‘terrain’ class. This is an expected consequence of our zero-shot VFM distillation without domain-specific prompt engineering, as 2D VFM could conflate terrain with vegetation. However, because both classes belong to the same broader category, our category-level mIoU (cat. mIoU) natively captures this structural understanding without penalty.
blocks.zh: 通过与相关作者的直接通信,我们确定LeAP[4]为65.3%的分数生成标签,而UniLiPs[6]则在训练集上标注平均47.32%的分数. 因为我们的方法从本质上支持通过我们选择性的分类公式对所有召回阈值进行持续评估,因此,我们直接对照这些基线,以确切的召回水平作为基准,确保绝对公平。 如图3所示,SplatLabel在所有召回级别上保持优异的业绩状况,即使在计算差异时,业绩始终高于基线操作点。 这些具体召回阈值的全球量化结果见表一。 如表一所示,我们的方法与 " terrain " 阶级格格不入。 这是我们零射VFM蒸馏的预期后果,没有特定域的快速工程,因为2D VFM可以将地形与植被混为一谈. 然而,由于两个班级都属于同一个更广泛的类别,所以我们这个类别级的mIoU(cat. mIoU)在本土上不惩罚地抓住了这种结构理解.

blocks.en: IV-C Semantic Occupancy Prediction
blocks.zh: IV-C 语义占用预测

blocks.en: Beyond point-level segmentation, we evaluate our performance on semantic occupancy prediction against AutoOcc [ 5 ] , the current state-of-the-art pseudo-labelling method. Following their evaluation protocol, we assess performance across 18 semantic classes, excluding the ambiguous “other flat/ground” class to ensure a fair comparison [ 5 ] . As qualitatively demonstrated in the bottom rows of Fig. 2 , our explicit kinematic parameterization successfully prevents the temporal smearing artifacts often present in aggregated ground truth data.
blocks.zh: 除了点级划分之外,我们对照AutoOcc[5],评估我们在语义占用预测方面的表现,这是目前最先进的伪标签方法. 根据他们的评估规程,我们评估18个语义类的业绩,不包括模棱两可的“其他平面/地面”类,以确保公平比较[5]。 如图2的底行所显示的那样,我们明确的运动参数化成功地防止了在汇总的地面真实数据中经常出现的时间涂抹文物。

blocks.en: As shown in Table II , our method demonstrates superior Geometric and Semantic IoU. To ensure the statistical significance of these improvements, we evaluated our method across five random seeds. We observed a minimal standard deviation of just 0.066 0.066 and 0.041 0.041 percentage points for Geometric IoU and Semantic mIoU respectively. These microscopic variances are orders of magnitude smaller than the absolute performance margins we achieve over previous baselines, thoroughly solidifying the stability and superiority of our approach.
blocks.zh: 如表二所示,我们的方法显示了优异的几何和语义IoU。 为了确保这些改进的统计意义,我们评估了我们的方法,包括五个随机种子。 我们观测到几何IoU和语义mIoU的最小标准差分别为0.066 0.066和0.041 0.041个百分点. 这些微观差异比我们以往基线的绝对性能差幅小,充分巩固了我们方法的稳定性和优越性。

blocks.zh: IV-D 空间领域和一般风险评估

We determine this by comparing a LiDAR point’s true depth to the rendered depth map; a point is classified as unoccluded if its true depth does not exceed the rendered depth by more than a 0.5-meter tolerance.

blocks.en: IV-E Computational Resources
blocks.zh: 四-E 计算资源

blocks.en: All experiments are executed on a cluster utilizing 4 NVIDIA A40 GPUs concurrently. Because our pipeline divides the dataset into independent, approximately 20-second continuous scene splits, the optimization process is highly parallelizable, requiring a total end-to-end training time of 15.28 GPU hours for 3D LiDAR segmentation and 33.67 GPU hours for semantic occupancy prediction on the complete SemanticKITTI validation set. During the inference phase, the label generation process operates efficiently, taking an average of 0.28 and 4.62 seconds per frame for LiDAR segmentation and semantic occupancy prediction respectively, as measured on a single NVIDIA A40 GPU.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都同时在使用4个NVIDIA A40 GPU的集群上进行. 因为我们的输油管将数据集分为独立的,约20秒连续的场景分裂,优化过程高度平行,要求3D LiDAR分区的总端到端训练时间为15.28GPU小时,在完整的SemanticKITTI验证集上进行语义占用预测的总时间为33.67GPU小时. 在推论阶段,标签生成过程高效运行,在单NVIDIA A40 GPU上测得的LiDAR分化和语义占用预测分别每帧平均耗时0.28秒和4.62秒.

blocks.en: V Ablation Study
blocks.zh: V 读取研究

blocks.en: To isolate the individual contributions of our pipeline’s spatial, kinematic, and temporal mechanisms, we perform a leave-one-out ablation study, summarized in Table IV .
blocks.zh: 为了孤立我们管道的空间、动能和时间机制的个别贡献,我们进行了一个一停一停的研究,摘要见表四。

blocks.en: V- 1 Semantic and Geometric Priors
blocks.zh: V - 1 语义和几何前传

blocks.en: Replacing our continuous soft labels with traditional hard semantic assignments (w/ Hard Semantic Labels) severely degrades overall performance. This validates that backpropagating continuous soft semantics is critical for natively resolving categorical ambiguities through spatiotemporal consensus. Geometric priors are equally vital; removing Virtual Depth Maps, which integrate 360-degree LiDAR into unobserved regions, causes a massive drop in Geometric IoU. Finally, bypassing Geometry Filtering allows unconstrained floating artifacts and 2D-optimized noise to corrupt 3D pseudo-label generation, uniformly harming all metrics.
blocks.zh: 用传统的硬语义标记(w/硬语义标记)取代我们的连续软标签,严重地降低了整体性能. 这就证明,背信弃义的持续软语义对于通过瞬间共识在本地解决断然模糊问题至关重要。 几何前身同样至关重要;移除将360度的LiDAR集成到未观测区域中的虚拟深度地图,会导致几何IoU大量下降. 最后,绕过几何滤镜可以让不受约束的漂浮文物和2D优化噪声腐蚀3D伪标签生成,统一伤害所有度量.

blocks.en: V- 2 Spatiotemporal Kinematics
blocks.zh: V - 2 Spatiotemporal 动因学

blocks.en: Explicit kinematic parameterization is essential for accurately separating dynamic actors from static environments. Disabling the Gated Deformation Mask allows static structures to improperly track micro-motions rather than remaining firmly clamped to zero, introducing widespread geometric jitter that sharply reduces geometric and semantic fidelity. Furthermore, decoupling the lifespan from the deformation mask ( − - Coupled Lifespan) causes a consistent drop across all metrics. This indicates that ensuring static primitives retain a full, sequence-wide footprint is vital for maintaining global scene stability.
blocks.zh: 明确动态参数化对于将动态行为体与静态环境准确区分开来至关重要。 使Gated变形面具失效,使得静态结构不适当地跟踪微动,而不是固守到零,引入了广泛的几何特征,大大降低了几何和语义上的忠诚度. 此外,将寿命与变形面具(----------lispan)脱钩,导致所有指标持续下降。 这表明,确保静态原始人保持完整的、全序的足迹对于维持全球场景稳定至关重要。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: We presented SplatLabel, an automated 4D Gaussian Splatting pipeline designed specifically for 3D semantic pseudo-labelling and volumetric occupancy prediction. At its core, SplatLabel overcomes the bottlenecks of dynamic scene reconstruction by introducing an explicit temporal manifold. By parameterizing continuous motion, temporal lifespans, and physical existence boundaries as intrinsic primitive properties, our framework successfully tracks dynamic actors while cleanly preserving static backgrounds. This approach entirely eliminates the need for pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SplatLabel,一个自动的4D高斯电镀管道, 专门为3D语义伪标签和体积占用预测设计。 其核心是SplatLabel,通过引入一个明确的时间多元性来克服动态场景重建的瓶颈. 通过将持续运动、时间寿命和物理存在边界参数化为内在原始属性,我们的框架成功地跟踪了动态行为者,同时保持了静态背景。 这种方法完全消除了预先附加说明的3D边框的需要.

blocks.en: To robustly ground this temporal representation, we utilize a Spatiotemporal Sampling-Based Density Controller built on [ 17 ] that directly distills continuous soft semantics from 2D foundation models [ 14 ] and injects 360-degree LiDAR priors via virtual depth maps. Furthermore, to address systemic flaws in standard pseudo-label evaluation, we reformulated the task as selective classification using the AUGRC [ 15 ] metric, providing a mathematically grounded, bias-aware measure of precision-recall reliability. Experiments on SemanticKITTI demonstrate that SplatLabel consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across arbitrary recall levels, establishing a robust, annotation-free foundation for dynamic scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 为了有力地证明这种时间性表现,我们利用基于[17]的Spatiotemporal抽样密度控制器,直接从2D基础模型中提取连续的软语义[14],并通过虚拟深度图注入360度的LiDAR前传. 此外,为了解决标准伪标签评价的系统性缺陷,我们用AUGRC [15] 度量标准重新将这项任务定为有选择的分类,提供了基于数学的、有偏见的精确-召回可靠性衡量标准。 关于语义学KITTI的实验表明,SplatLabel在任意召回水平上一贯超过最新基线,为动态场景理解奠定了坚实、无注释的基础。

blocks.en: VI-A Limitations
blocks.zh: VI-A 限制

blocks.en: Our approach is constrained by the high VRAM requirements inherent to dense 3DGS [ 7 ] optimization and relies on precise camera-LiDAR synchronization. Additionally, because the pipeline depends heavily on camera imagery for dense semantics and LiDAR for structural geometry, its robustness inherently degrades in adverse lighting or weather conditions where sensor inputs are compromised.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法受到密集的3DGS[7]优化所固有的高VRAM要求的制约,并依赖于精确的相机-LiDAR同步. 此外,由于输油管严重依赖高密度语义学的摄像头和结构几何学的LiDAR,其稳健性在影响传感器输入的不利照明或天气条件下必然会退化。

blocks.en: VI-B Future Work
blocks.zh: 未来工作

blocks.en: For future work, we plan to validate the practical efficacy of our generated labels directly on downstream tasks. This will involve training downstream semantic segmentation and occupancy models purely on our generated annotations and benchmarking their final performance against models trained on human-annotated ground truth. Finally, because our pipeline natively outputs predictive confidence scores via spatial consensus, future research will explore integrating these uncertainty metrics directly into downstream training processes to dynamically weight loss functions.
blocks.zh: 对于今后的工作,我们计划验证我们产生的标签在下游任务上的实际效力。 这将涉及完全根据我们生成的说明来培训下游语义分区和占用模式,并对照经过人文说明的地面真相培训的模式来衡量其最终业绩。 最后,由于我们的管道本身通过空间共识产生预测性信心分数,未来的研究将探索将这些不确定性指标直接纳入下游培训过程,以动态地加权计算损失功能。
